svg.title: What each evidence layer can establish
svg.desc: Observation: Calibration, provenance and context concern the real-world reading.. Signature: An attributable message under key and cryptographic assumptions.. Retention: Bytes, schema and permissions remain available.. Commitment: Retained bytes match a common reference and inclusion proof.. Acceptance: Participants check current history and settlement policy.. Evidence at a later layer cannot repair missing evidence at an earlier one.

g.text: What each evidence layer can establish
Calibration, provenance and context concern the real-world reading.
An attributable message under key and cryptographic assumptions.
Bytes, schema and permissions remain available.
Retained bytes match a common reference and inclusion proof.
Participants check current history and settlement policy.
Evidence at a later layer cannot repair missing evidence at an earlier
